Implemented a CSV export endpoint for user items with the following changes:

**Modified file:** `backend/app/api/routes/items.py`
- Added imports: `csv`, `io`, `StreamingResponse`
- Added new GET endpoint `/items/export/csv` that:
  - Returns all items for superusers
  - Returns only the current user's items for regular users
  - Generates a CSV file with columns: id, title, description, created_at
  - Returns the file as a downloadable attachment with proper headers

**Modified file:** `backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`
- Added imports: `csv`, `io`
- Added two test cases:
  - `test_export_items_csv`: Verifies superusers can export all items as CSV
  - `test_export_items_csv_empty`: Verifies normal users with no items get an empty CSV (header only)

**Endpoint details:**
- URL: `GET /api/v1/items/export/csv`
- Returns: CSV file download with name `items.csv`
- Authentication: Required (uses `CurrentUser` dependency)
- Access control: Respects user permissions (superusers see all items, regular users see only their own)
